node.title: diffuse triple-shadow theorem
node.statement: Poly count for diffuse m>=4 triple-shadow syzygies — the final residue of the slope sieve (see statement.md; fresh-rank 2n + Vandermonde lemma + triple payment PROVED).
node.notes: AMBER STRESS 2026-07-06: diffuse_shadow_circuit_scan.py searched small finite-field Hankel locator models over F_13/mu_12, F_17/mu_8, and F_17/mu_16.
